title: Improve conditional T530 κ through two commuting release retimings
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Summary.** Two adjacent shared-source ADD pairs in **each** pinned PR3605 supplier commute exactly. Retiming their releases changes the relevant helper frame paths from `1 → 2 → 4` to `1 → 4`, preserving the operator, helper identities, widths and boundary interfaces. Each invocation replaces `2H1 + 2H2` with `2H3`.

Applied to PR3626's actual 4,770-call T530 allocation, this yields the conditional endpoint

**κ = 0.001730394391813963415120 − 10^-46 − 10^-70**, an absolute improvement of **3.2252710818353258e-7** (about **0.0186424%**) over that pinned direct predecessor.

The exact commuting/frame argument, complete paid profile, two-engine root enclosure and transfer chain are in [`PROOF.md`](https://github.com/roger-sato/integer-mult-bounds/blob/80c0f2906d4ecd66325c42fcf3cfd5070a088bdb/research/staged-release-retiming-t530/PROOF.md). The full profile is `{1:11747920,2:3453480,3:1112042,4:486540,5:103690,8:38160,48:202828}`; live/physical stock is 474,880/475,389; global prefix/reserve/payload is 1,479/1,512/2,048 bits.

**Remaining assumptions:** inherited all-size dispatch/compiler and recursive rounding; common-label/mutable-source realization and whole-call hosting; SCALAR/COPY/CLEAR and zero-allocation contracts; uniform coefficient/stock, bootstrap, precision, tape/recovery, and analytic/BIT H1–H5 premises. Finite checks do not discharge these general premises. This draft makes no unconditional theorem, formal-kernel, independent human review, global-best or priority claim. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## Task and overlap

- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`.
- Supplier source: #3605 at `3efbb5de06a49ffeea6684482f2d3fe48cdca3fb`.
- Direct predecessor/allocation: #3626 at `659fd5e7064d9466b668d7188cbb013b333a415a`.
- Comparison: #3633 at `46c5aaca40117a4ca90a3316771ae52cf9a6801e` reaches the old inventory's ceiling. This change improves the local bill underlying that ceiling; combining with its T488 allocation is **untested**.
- #3630 supplies the fixed-inventory dual basis. The new relaxed ceiling is a scoped bound, not an additional achieved κ.

This is user-directed research, retrospectively classified under `scalar-to-moment` with **refined** scope. The improvement is in the complete paid profile, not scalar addition count alone. The overlap refresh covered open PRs/discussions and local records; it is not a novelty certificate. At publication, #3633 had advanced to `72c268f113368ea0387d188225e3f81ba6d6ef73` for an attribution correction; its stated endpoint was unchanged from our comparison pin.

## Validation

**Test plan and results.** Reproduction instructions and per-component scope are in [`README.md`](https://github.com/roger-sato/integer-mult-bounds/blob/80c0f2906d4ecd66325c42fcf3cfd5070a088bdb/research/staged-release-retiming-t530/README.md). Bounded checks use Python 3.12 / NumPy 2.5.4:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/staged-release-retiming-t530 --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/staged-release-retiming-t530
```

- [x] The original bounded package replay passed in about 24.2 seconds; no package writes. Committed bytes match all package files and declared inputs. Declared Git pins are ancestors of this publication.
- [x] Exact local proof, both complete free-operator words, 632 arbitrary input columns in both orientations, 91 zero buffers, and rejection controls.
- [x] Fresh reconstruction and independent audit of all **1,946,160 owner roles**, capacities, chronological prefixes and complete invoice; five rejection controls.
- [x] Two rational root engines, **63 strict transfer inequalities**, **17 rejection controls**, and independent balance derivation.
- [x] All **2,551** scoped packing patterns: 2,539 strictly positive reduced costs and 12 symbolic zeros.
- [x] In the original scientific run, both changed native providers were freshly checked; all **seven admission stages** exit 0, terminal `PASS_RELEASE`. Two unchanged native chains and the retained parent were authenticated and reused. Full admission took about 20.3 minutes excluding earlier native generation.
- [x] Public source reconstruction reproduces the identical **654-file** source manifest `fb47533a401d1d13719be8b9aab91fe5313931ca62d40dba336eab6a96275aa0`.
- [x] **The published full wrapper completed end to end in 1,271.67 seconds (21m 12s)** on macOS 27.0 arm64 / Python 3.12.14, from publication commit `abc12f62e4fe9bfcb2e33c84703253c918668351`, in a fresh external work directory without a supplied allocation. All **seven wrapper stages and seven nested admission stages** exited 0. Terminal `PASS_RETIMER_T530_COMPLETE_CONDITIONAL_RELEASE` / `PASS_RELEASE` reproduced the same exact κ and 654-file source manifest. Both changed native providers and all 1,946,160 owner roles were regenerated; two unchanged native chains and the retained parent remained authenticated reuse. All 295 original package files stayed unchanged; **no wrapper code fix was needed**. See the separate [full-replay record](https://github.com/roger-sato/integer-mult-bounds/blob/80c0f2906d4ecd66325c42fcf3cfd5070a088bdb/research/staged-release-retiming-t530/PUBLIC-FULL-REPLAY.json). This long replay remains outside bounded CI.
- [x] The updated bounded package verification also checks the new receipt chain and four semantic rejection controls (unfinished attempt, external allocation, missing nested gate, stale terminal receipt). The compact evidence checker and controls passed under normal Python and `-O`; those checks validate recorded evidence, not another long scientific run.

The lean public package omits regenerated large archives/fill and retains required pinned dependencies, code, proof and evidence. Execution-path metadata is normalized with original/public SHA256 maps. The quick recorded-summary check verifies public integrity and internal references; it does **not** authenticate omitted archive bytes or rerun native/controller/outer admission. Original scientific inputs and earlier receipts remain unchanged. The public-wrapper run has its own new receipt chain; its raw local source/runtime/native/log bytes were checked before publishing normalized metadata. A later independent run in another environment and all general theorem assumptions remain open.

## Open next questions

The smallest follow-up is to bind these exact words into PR3633's T488 allocation and repeat complete owner/controller/prefix/outer admission; no predicted value from that composition is included here. Further word/inventory changes may exceed the narrow fixed-inventory headroom. Independently proving an inherited all-size premise would strengthen the theorem's status. First steps and blockers are listed in the package's [Open next questions](https://github.com/roger-sato/integer-mult-bounds/blob/80c0f2906d4ecd66325c42fcf3cfd5070a088bdb/research/staged-release-retiming-t530/README.md#open-next-questions).
